method: Viewed all six original product references and each tight input crop; reviewed six source/generated/341:272 comparison sheets, and full-resolution Camille and Meridian hardware. Visual review checks reference-relative product construction and material appearance.
metric_scale: Not verifiable from isolated uncalibrated macros; no measurements added.

crop_test.verdict: Key panel subject readable in all24 previews.

meridian-craft-material.notes: Pebbled Brown body retained. Raking highlight clarifies natural fold; pore rendering regenerated.

meridian-craft-stitching.notes: Single curved front seam and adjacent pebbled leather retained; no added stitch row.

meridian-craft-finishing.notes: Curved gusset and layered edge retained with neutral shadow; no extra panel.

meridian-craft-hardware.notes: Silver center plate/post and both slotted ends retain orientation/overlap. Full-resolution inspected; source does not certify mechanism details.

camille-craft-material.notes: Cream canvas weave retained without added props or surface features.

camille-craft-stitching.notes: Navy flat strip and two cream stitch lines retained.

camille-craft-finishing.notes: Cream lower corner, Navy border and existing gold foot retained.

camille-craft-hardware.notes: Gold front fitting, small upright part, Navy belt and raw canvas edge retained. Full-resolution source and output inspected.

colette-craft-material.notes: Pale oatmeal felt-like matte fiber texture retained; no knit or leather substitution.

colette-craft-stitching.notes: Caramel belt retains tonal stitch lines, two felt keepers and front felt strips.

colette-craft-finishing.notes: Felt gusset curve, edge thickness and partial existing cap retained.

colette-craft-hardware.notes: One curved Caramel belt end and one round gold-tone cap retained; revised source crop gives cap enough vertical space.

delphine-craft-stitching.notes: Burnished warm leather flap, curved edge stitch row and small existing rivet retained.

delphine-craft-finishing.notes: Corner cap curve, tonal seam, adjacent twill and existing foot retained.

delphine-craft-hardware.notes: One diagonal slotted gold plate, two rivets and original strap overlap retained; creative target fidelity, not physical hardware certification.

juliette-craft-material.notes: Camel suede nap retained; relighting/restage strengthens a soft fold without structural changes.

juliette-craft-stitching.notes: Dark collar seam, one keeper/bar in crop and adjacent suede retained.

juliette-craft-finishing.notes: One curved dark corner cap, seam and small brass stud retained.

juliette-craft-hardware.notes: One flat antique-brass bar, keeper and pointed decorative belt end retained.

weekender-craft-material.notes: Actual Army Green canvas color/weave retained; loose incidental lint cleaned.

weekender-craft-stitching.notes: Real contoured leather flap seam and horizontal oval retained. At341:272 upper plate partly crops while intended seam stays clear.

weekender-craft-finishing.notes: Actual warm-brown corner reinforcement, piping and green canvas retained; floor restaged warm-neutral.

weekender-craft-hardware.notes: Actual HORIZONTAL gold oval, empty shaped slot and two side rivets retained; no vertical oval or center turn post invented.
